title: Predictive Maintenance System
summary: A production-grade predictive maintenance platform for industrial machinery that combines synthetic sensor data generation, AutoGluon-based ML models, LLM explanations, and a monitoring dashboard. Its GAN module trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on physics-based seed data to augment scarce sensor readings, validating results with sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality and standalone sdmetrics QualityReport/KSComplement checks.
evidence: GAN/scripts/train_tvae_machine.py:16-18 imports TVAESynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, evaluate_quality and fits/samples synthetic data
